episodes.163915: Slow moving low pressure and its associated warm front caused rain to overspread the area. Subtropical moisture was wrapped into this system, which led to instances of heavy rain and flooding.
episodes.163916: Slow moving low pressure and its associated warm front caused rain to overspread the area. Subtropical moisture was wrapped into this system, which led to instances of heavy rain and flooding.
episodes.163924: Low pressure over the Ohio Valley allowed southeast winds out ahead of the storm system to draw in deep Atlantic moisture across Central New York. This combined with an upper level disturbance sweeping through the area produced widespread moderate to heavy rainfall. This rain came on the heels of a heavy rain day three days prior, making it easier for additional flash flooding to develop.
episodes.163925: Low pressure over the Ohio Valley allowed southeast winds out ahead of the storm system to draw in deep Atlantic moisture across Eastern Pennsylvania. This combined with an upper level disturbance sweeping through the area produced widespread moderate to heavy rainfall. This rain came on the heels of a heavy rain day three days prior, making it easier for additional flash flooding to develop.
episodes.164033: A broad occluded low advanced northeastward from the Ohio Valley. Easterly moisture feed off the Atlantic ahead of this system brought precipitable water values above 1 inch. A vast area of moderate and occasionally heavy rainfall resulted in areas of flooding.
